Great Copperas Cove Location, Right price, Right time: Traditional House Ready to Welcome You Home!
This house is ideally situated in an established, well-maintained neighborhood and is move-in ready. Everything you need is within easy reach; local shops, gas stations, schools, restaurants, parks and entertainment. It is conveniently located just under 7 miles away from the Fort Cavazos Clark Rd. Gate, about 11 minutes driving distance. This traditional home features 3-bedroom, 2-bathroom, and a comfortable and practical layout for everyday living, a fresh paint job, newly remodeled kitchen, thoughtfully designed for efficiency and ideal for cooking and entertaining. This home also features wood laminate and tile combination floors all over the house, and beautiful original details that add charm and personality. Immerse yourself in the friendly surroundings and the warm and inviting atmosphere this home offers, perfect for those who appreciate a timeless design with modern convenience. Whether you’re a first-time homebuyer or looking to downsize, this property has everything you need for comfortable living. Embrace the opportunity to personalize each space with your own style and preferences, creating a home that truly reflects your family's personality and values.

2 full bath
